items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999

ctx.x: That’s what everybody says, is that you? That’s why I had to quit. When I was going to Europe with Peanuts Hucko, we had the program notes, and after the concert people would come in the office into the dressing room and they would open up the program to your picture — oh there’s Trummy Young — and when they came to me they were looking to the picture. Oh now here we are, is that you? I said that’s it, I’ve got to get some new pictures. That’s my wife when I met her. This is Bob Astor, Shelly Manne, Chico Marx.…
Well let me get some shots of these why don’t we wrap up. And we’ll see if we can go with that. That’s terrific. Thanks.
